facts.text: The bridge README describes the node as a bridge between libfreenect2 and ROS.
initialize reads the private base_name parameter with std::string(K2_DEFAULT_NS) as its default.
The topic macros define the /sd group and the /image_color, /image_depth, /image_ir, _rect and /camera_info suffixes.
initTopics composes the SD color-rectified, depth-rectified and raw IR topic names from those macros.
initTopics advertises sensor_msgs::Image and sensor_msgs::CompressedImage publishers for every composed topic as base_name + topics[i].
initTopics advertises sensor_msgs::CameraInfo on base_name + K2_TOPIC_SD + K2_TOPIC_INFO.
The constructor sets sizeColor to 1920x1080, sizeIr to 512x424 and sizeLowRes to half sizeColor.
The README states that the SD raw IR and depth topics carry 512x424 images.
createImage assigns TYPE_16UC1 to the IR and depth images, BGR8 to the color images and TYPE_8UC1 to the mono images.
createImage copies the Mat height, width and step, sets is_bigendian to false and copies the byte payload into the ROS Image.
The SD color-rectified image is produced by registration->apply into sizeIr buffers and converted from BGRA/RGBA to BGR.
The SD depth-rectified image is produced by remapping depthShifted at sizeIr.
createCameraInfo copies its size argument into CameraInfo height and width; infoIR is created with sizeIr.
publishImages assigns the frame id baseNameTF + K2_TF_IR_OPT_FRAME to the SD group, including the SD CameraInfo.
callbackStatus starts the device streams when a client subscribes and stops the device when no client remains.
The README states that images from the same frame share a timestamp and recommends ExactTime synchronization.
The README states that point clouds are only published when the launch file is used.
